title: Decide: AU lookup activation when auval cache is missing
description: Spec §'Open questions' #1. When ~/.cache/lpx-toolkit/auval.json doesn't exist, do we (a) spawn 'auval -l' ourselves (slow, can take 5-30s, segfault risk if user runs --a, but we'd use --l), (b) stay neutral grey until the user runs the Python tool, or (c) ship a 'Run AU scan' CTA that the user opts into? Suggest (b) for v1; revisit when AU-lookup epic starts.
acceptance_criteria: Decision logged in docs/decisions.md; either implemented or deferred to a future bead with clear scope.
close_reason: Resolved: stay neutral grey + one-time 'Run AU scan' CTA. Rust auval parser ships with epic 59o. Logged in docs/decisions.md 2026-05-04 #1.
